activation.T0: First official 15-minute contract open strictly after separately signed capture activation. No scoring before activation.
required: trusted per-domain clock certificates and continuous invalidation
complete lane-specific producers and official eligible-contract catalog
hosted nonproduction OFF/ON and OFF/OFF gates
explicit start boundary and signed partition manifest
approval for any new paid resource

partition_rules.membership: Official contract open relative to T0. All origins/events for one contract stay together. A boundary contract is never split.
partition_rules.seal: Validation/final outcome access must be denied to development readers; capture may archive bytes without making outcome tables available. Freeze candidate and extraction hashes before validation; freeze finalist before final release.
partition_rules.failure_to_seal: Mark that block previously inspected; it cannot serve as unseen final prospective evidence.
partition_rules.small_sample: Counts are feasibility floors, not a power guarantee. If unmet, report insufficient precision; never extend a block after viewing outcomes or silently move contracts. Any new protocol uses a newly declared future T0.
partition_rules.subgroups: Below 30 unique contracts or 30 relevant events, report counts and unavailable inference. Display wide intervals above this floor as warranted.
partition_rules.candidate_authority: Current EARLY family is not automatically the candidate. Development may discover whether genuine richer evidence supplies a useful discriminator. No threshold changes during collection.
partition_rules.modification_budget: At most three interpretable hypotheses total per lane, only after a documented failure of the frozen baseline. Preregister hypotheses and extraction before validation. No hundreds-of-threshold search. No modifications have been proposed by this infrastructure mission.

completeness_gates.population: 100% of official scheduled eligible contracts accounted for, including missing capture, quiet, WAIT, rejected and suppressed. Unknown catalog coverage blocks all coverage claims.
completeness_gates.individual_scoring: Require complete immutable origin, bound producer/run/build identity, valid intervals for required ordering/freshness, exact original quote identity, no unresolved gaps over required horizon, complete causal transitions, and authoritative outcome when settlement is used. Otherwise UNAVAILABLE, retained in denominator.
completeness_gates.coverage_floor_scope: At least 99% of eligible-contract observation windows complete and at least 99% of relevant origins fully scoreable in each partition for lane-level conclusions. Report every exclusion and time/contract distribution; no assumed missing-at-random.
completeness_gates.quotes: Require explicit source/book continuity and receipt/delivery identity. A 1-second sampled common snapshot is not proof of every exchange quote. No interpolation; target-stop order inside a gap is unavailable.
completeness_gates.settlement: Official authoritative settlement/closeout only. BRTI final60 inference requires established complete 60/60 score contract; incomplete is unavailable.
completeness_gates.historical_status: Previously inspected historical evidence is descriptive only. No historical row becomes prospective validation.

early.denominator: Every eligible contract, every scheduled genuine evaluation, all gate-pass/fail/rejected/suppressed/no-signal events. Freeze source feature cutoff and full conditions.
metrics: entry ASK distribution, fair/edge calibration and Brier score where a true probability is emitted
causal same-side BID trajectories at 30/60/120 seconds and close
early.no_pnl_claim: No executable directional exit is validated. Quotes are descriptive; never claim fills or realized P&L.

final.research_origin_rule: For each contract, freeze the first causally qualified protected EARLY publication with source FROZEN_TIER1, a UP/DOWN side, boolean ready, and original paired same-side quotes during elapsed seconds [60,600]. Keep ready true/false strata. No FINAL, future prices or settlement may decide origin membership. Explicit RESEARCH_ONLY ID is never an accepted BUY or native decision ID.
final.actual_origins: Analyze genuine existing EARLY authority origins separately when explicitly linked. Never fabricate an accepted trade.
final.existing_semantics: Replay existing dcc44cc semantics unchanged only with complete required input/state. Distinguish valid opposing FINAL ready=false from qualified opposing ready=true. Disagreement alone never EXIT.
metrics: first loss and first opposing publication
settlement correctness conditional on confirmation, weakening and opposition
original ASK and same-side BID immediately before/at/after event
final.phase_fields: 5M CAUTION, 3M GUARD and Flip Risk require their genuine producer/version/definition and contract binding. Time buckets are not replacements.

scalp.policy: Score each actually evidenced native true-SCALP, V8.1 and serial policy separately, unchanged. Never pool policy eras or retirement semantics.
scalp.matrix: Full 4-by-4 descriptive target/stop grid. Exact decimal BID minus immutable original ASK; strictly later only. First witnessed crossing wins only if path complete. A gap spanning a possible earlier crossing makes order unavailable. No future-max action.
scalp.horizon: Publication/qualified first quote through official close; continue capture after protection to describe foregone later opportunity. Actual policy retirement/exit remain distinct.
metrics: entry ASK mean median quantiles and <=50c / 25-35c shares
MFE/MAE distributions and time to first extrema
time to target stop arm protection
protection gain retained/given back and later foregone gain
gross cents only where actual causal exit rule exists
overlapping origins, suppressed candidates and separation intervals
scalp.entry_mismatch: Preserve published entry and observed original/first post-publication ASK separately. Existing 40c published/57c observed class cannot be silently rebased or rescored as a different origin.
scalp.primary_target: Intracontract price path; settlement direction is not the primary SCALP target.

uncertainty.proportions: 95% Wilson intervals for unique-contract outcomes; origin/signal summaries additionally use 2000-replicate contract-cluster bootstrap with seed 20260929.
uncertainty.dependence: Keep all signals from a resampled contract together. Report unique days and contract counts. Day-block sensitivity required for any candidate promotion claim.
uncertainty.missing: Report coverage and worst/best possible bounds separately from observed estimates; missing is never automatically loss, PASS, HOLD or synthetic exit.
uncertainty.multiplicity: All preregistered target/stop cells reported. No selecting the best cell as a validated strategy. Development-only subgroup findings remain exploratory.

promotion: No result is production-qualified. A candidate requires separately reviewed prospective evidence and completed live admission infrastructure.
